what: Major Mexican financial newspaper positions Kichink's business model as disruptive versus other platforms, contrasting its per-transaction commission with competitors' upfront or monthly fees.
verbatim_snippet: "El modelo de negocio de Kichink resulta disruptivo frente a otras plataformas, pues a diferencia de cobrar un precio de entrada o mensual, solicitan una comisión en promedio de 7.5 por ciento por cada transacción."
notes: El Financiero is a major Mexican business/financial newspaper. Content confirmed via Google search snippets; page not directly fetchable at time of research. Article also quotes co-founder Claudia de Heredia. Competitors named: other platforms (generic). Comparison dimension: business model / pricing structure. Specific numbers: 7.5% average commission; 200%+ annual growth; 55,000 stores; 2,000 profitable stores.
